excerpt.zh:
这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
excerpt.en:
The Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

texts.zh:
这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
texts.en:
The Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

responses.zh: 我在庭荠磁舵星姐妹会长大。和其她姐妹一样完成完成学业后，我被委任到了这个外派岗位上。多年来，我一直为别人出谋划策。对此斗胆一言，我还取得了一些小小的成功。
responses.en: I was raised in the Sisterhood of the Alyssum Magnetar. When my training was complete, like all my Sisters, I was assigned to an offworld position. For many years I provided counsel, and if I may be so bold as to claim it, I enjoyed some modest success.

label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

responses.zh: 我相信和平是唯一能给我们星系带来稳定未来的东西。外交的艺术如在刀尖上舞蹈。我相信你一定会重视这方面的。
responses.en: I believe that peace is the only thing that can create a stable future for our galaxy. The art of diplomacy is a subtle thing. I believe you can respect this.

label.en: Do you still serve the Sisterhood?

responses.zh: 我为一切生命效力。来吧，我们边喝杯热饮边继续这个话题。
responses.en: I serve all life. Now come, let's say we continue this conversation over a warm drink?

tooltips.en: Vas the Gilded joins our empire as a Leader.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：本国有和平思潮时才可能抽到此人（每十年由隐藏事件40000/40001抽签，需典范DLC、外星语言学、非AI、非杀戮帝国）。打听问题只显示回答；“解雇”后不会再出现；“招募”后才会有后续故事。
notes.en: Review note: offered only to empires with the pacifist ethic (decade lottery via hidden 40000/40001: Paragon, Xeno-Linguistics, not AI, not homicidal). Questions only show replies; dismissing removes the offer for good; only hiring unlocks the later episodes.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]因举办奢华宴会而享有盛誉。这些宴会以庭荠磁舵星成员的精彩表演、奇异的食物和饮料以及哲学和伦理讨论而闻名。在这里，人们建立有意，促成交易，解开心结。[Root.GetHisHerCap]将这么多千差万别的人凝聚起来的能力是我们繁荣发展的坚实基础。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has garnered a wide reputation for hosting lavish feasts. The gatherings are known for spectacular performances by members of the Alyssum Magnetar, exotic food and drink, as well as philosophical and ethical discussions. Here friendships are formed, business deals are struck and old grievances are forgiven. [Root.GetHisHerCap] ability to unite such disparate individuals lays a solid foundation for our future prosperity.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]简直是一位劝诱方面的艺术家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]利用[Root.GetHisHer]的人脉和政治影响力从整个星系收集重要信息。[Root.GetFirstName]把[Root.GetHisHer]所有的知识都保存在一件传家宝里：一块浅绿色的水晶，[Root.GetHeShe]偶尔会在[Root.GetHisHer]的奢华宴会上佩戴。当在特定的光谱下观察时，它的秘密就会以一个壮丽光晕的形式投射出来。现在[Root.GetHeShe]认为是时候利用这些知识造福社会了。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] is a true artiste when it comes to charm and persuasion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has used [Root.GetHisHer] contacts and political clout to gather vital information from all over the galaxy. [Root.GetFirstName] has kept all of [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge in a family heirloom: a pale green crystal that [Root.GetHeShe] occasionally wears at [Root.GetHisHer] lavish feasts. When held up to a specific spectrum of light, its secrets are projected in a magnificent halo. Now, [Root.GetHeShe] believes the time has come to use this knowledge for the good of society.

label.en: It will be put to good use.

summary.text:
# 万人迷沃斯 / Vas the Gilded

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/paragon_events_4.txt:1250-1340、3283-3305, 3309-3344、1728–1866（paragon.41234）、15–160（paragon.40000/40001）· DLC：典范 Galactic Paragons · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“知名领袖”抽签：每十年（on_decade_pulse_country）隐藏事件 paragon.40000 检查（典范DLC、玩家、非杀戮帝国、已研究外星语言学、近期未招募），按基础1（有招募办公室+2）对“随失败而递增”的权重决定是否在1–360天内抽签（40001）。抽签只放入与本国思潮相符、尚未出现过且未被解雇的领袖；本故事的人物属于**和平**思潮（renowned_pacifist2）。
Renowned leader lottery: each decade hidden paragon.40000 (Paragon, player, not homicidal, Xeno-Linguistics, no recent recruit) may draw within 1–360 days (40001); only leaders matching your ethics, not yet offered and not dismissed are in the pool. This one is **pacifist**.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 招募对话：珠光宝气的修女，愿任总督与外交官。可反复询问（只显示回答），然后“解雇”或“招募”。
   Recruitment: an opulent Sister offering to serve as governor and diplomat. Ask questions (replies only), then dismiss or enlist.
2. 招募后，每十年隐藏事件 paragon.41234 随机挑选一名知名领袖，对此人按10%/10%/80%抽取下面两段故事之一或都不发生，延迟1–1800天；两段都只发生一次，可在不同的十年里先后出现。
   After hiring, every decade paragon.41234 picks a renowned leader; for this one 10% / 10% / 80% (nothing), 1–1800 days later. Each episode fires once; both may happen in different decades.

- **和平与繁荣 / Peace and Prosperity**（paragon.41210）：奢华宴会凝聚人心：获得修正。
  her lavish feasts unite people: a modifier.
- **在我们需要的时候 / In Our Time of Need**（paragon.41220）：利用人脉与政治影响力在危难时刻相助：获得凝聚力与影响力。
  she uses her contacts and clout in our time of need: unity and influence.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- “解雇”：人物回到全局池，但本国设置 dismissed 标记，以后不会再抽到。“招募”：成为知名领袖（李萨拓等人另带舰队）。
  Dismiss: never offered to you again. Enlist: becomes a renowned leader.
- 两段后续是相互独立的随机事件，不是先后两章；领袖死亡或离开后不再发生。
  The two episodes are independent random events, not chapters in order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 只有拥有和平思潮的帝国会被提供此人。后续故事的额外条件见上（括号内）。
  Offered only to pacifist empires; extra episode conditions are given in brackets above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：40000/40001 抽签与权重（01_script_values_paragon.txt ethic_leader_randomizer）、招募事件全部选项、ethic_leader_hire_effect 设置领袖标记、41234 的分派与权重、后续事件的触发条件、选项与项目。
- 更正 Corrections：原先十六名领袖的招募对话被合成一个故事（按抽签器），而所有后续故事又被合成另一个故事；现按人物拆分，每人一则故事，招募后接各自的后续。
  The lottery-based story and the follow-up story were split into one story per leader.
- 不确定 Uncertain：每十年只随机挑选一名知名领袖进行判定，拥有多名知名领袖时后续可能更晚出现。
